title: nutty vietnamese mung-bean-sprout-sukju spring-rolls
description: a nostalgic vietnamese dish featuring spherified mung-bean-sprout-sukju, crunchy vegetables, and a nutty sauce. perfect for a keto-friendly snack or lunch.
instructions: immerse the mung-bean sprouts in cold water for at least 4 hours or overnight.
drain and rinse the mung-bean sprouts, then set aside.
pulse the cauliflower in a food processor until it resembles rice.
sauté the cauliflower 'rice' in coconut oil until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and ginger to the cauliflower and stir-fry for 1 minute.
season the cauliflower mixture with fish sauce and lime juice.
mix the mung-bean sprouts, sukju, carrots, and cucumber in a bowl.
add the nutty sauce to the vegetable mixture and stir until well combined.
spherify the mixture using sodium alginate and water according to the manufacturer's instructions.
heat a small amount of oil in a pan over medium heat.
fry the spherified spring rolls until crispy and golden brown, about 5 minutes per side.
